The '''Uogo'cor suppression''' was a suppression operation executed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] onto the [[Dark Warbirds]]. The concentrated assault on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Uogo'cor/Legends|Uogo'cor]] by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] resulted in the destruction of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Gangster/Legends|gang]].

==Prelude==
For many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], several [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangs]] fought for control of the [[Uogo'cor system/Legends|Uogo'cor system]], a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] strategically located on the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]], a major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|shipping lane]] that crossed the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]].<ref name="GK" /><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Becoming rich from their raids, the pirates of the Trax Tube were able to afford the construction of elaborate, fully functioning [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] around the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] of the Uogo'cor system.<ref name="GK" /><ref name="AJ2">{{JournalCite|2|Rebel Privateers!}}</ref>

At some point, one pirate gang, the [[Dark Warbirds]], settled on the main [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the system, [[Uogo'cor/Legends|Uogo'cor]]. The harsh world, known for its long, frigid winters and short, but intensely hot summers, hosted a small population of diminutive [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], the [[Uogo]], whose name for their planet translated as "home of the suffering ones." The Dark Warbirds settled on Uogo'cor in the belief that a planetary base would be much easier to defend, and started to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the native population.<ref name="GK" />

The Dark Warbirds held control of the system for many years,<ref name="GK" /> and Uogo'cor became a famous [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]],<ref name="PP" /><ref name="TEA" /> selling its services to any [[Starship/Legends|ship]] regardless of registry, history or crew.<ref name="AJ2" />

==The suppression==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="date" /> and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Uogo'cor and obliterated the Dark Warbirds, along with many of the Uogo.<ref name="GK" />

The Uogo'cor suppression, as well as the [[Eyttyrmin Batiiv]] suppression at the [[Battle of Khuiumin]], became excellent examples of pirate-suppressing missions. These operations usually involved elements from [[Force superiority|superiority forces]],<ref name="PP" /> such as [[battle squadron]]s that contained an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="IS">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> They could also be carried out by elements from [[Force escort|escort forces]], such as [[heavy squadron]]s.<ref name="PP" />

==Aftermath==
After the suppression of the Dark Warbirds, [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] remained on Uogo'cor to protect new [[Colonist/Legends|settlers]], while military strategists devised a plan to halt the piracy once and for all in the system.<ref name="GK" />

Some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the operation, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sent several [[Agent/Legends|agents]] to Uogo'cor, hoping to rally the Uogo and the native inhabitants against the Galactic Empire. Alliance [[operative]]s also investigated the possibility of starting a [[Rebel privateer|privateer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the Uogo'cor system in order to waylay Imperial shipping.<ref name="GK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Uogo'cor suppression was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Kit]]'', a [[1991]] sourcebook co-written by [[Bill Smith]] and [[Ed Stark]], which was published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GK" />
